summary: Pins django-lux 1.8.6 for the updater state-row and runtime-volume fixes, retires the forked detail modal, and refreshes the system-settings snapshot.
highlights: django-lux 1.8.6: the update panel reports the installed version again and no longer offers a stale rollback target.
The forked dynamic_modal_detail.html is archived under .xpose/ now that dlux renders extra_detail_fields itself.
config.json refreshed from the live stack: public storefront and homepage builder settings, mono theme, tabbed options.
